narrative.weekly_mirror: Having biryani with Priya while still reviewing the numbers made the meal feel as though it “deserved better attention than that.” Later, eating egg curry slowly and noticing the kitchen smell gave you a small stretch of enjoyment without turning it into another task.
narrative.tension_explanation: Work seems to follow you into the same room, the same meals, and even the pauses that might otherwise help you feel at home. Your father’s fifteen quiet minutes came back to you as a possible kind of space you don’t really have yet, while the guilt around enjoying ordinary things still seems close by.
narrative.reflective_question: When you think about your father’s fifteen minutes, what would a similar gap have felt like after the biryani with Priya?
